mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates labor market weakness and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal broad consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production relative to prior month indicates weakening manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1350 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1350.0, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) indicates restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or interaction signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high employment growth periods (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), labor market strength supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during high employment growth, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.
